name: river-chronicles-gods-of-the-nile
description: Editable two-mode 3D educational game with seven deity duels and textbook collection cards.

scripts.check: node --check model.js && node --check scene.js && node --check game.js && node --check gods-data.js && node --check god-models.js && node --check gods.js
